title: Zeema Component
description: A concrete implementation of exactly one kind (for example kafka is a queue).

docs.description: Official documentation page for this product.

aliases.description: Other names the vendor's own documentation uses for this product: abbreviations (DCR) and product nicknames (S3). Searched alongside the id and the name; never invented here.

defaults.description: Overrides of the kind property defaults. Keys must exist on the kind.

properties.description: Component-specific properties added on top of the kind properties.

provider.description: Vendor that owns the product; also the subfolder of components/ the file lives in. default = open source, in-house generic, or SaaS.
